speaker: Bobby Chen-Ramirez
cascadeSummary: Closed Phase 1 with HCAI sign-off on seismic submittals and excavation completion. Approved double shifts continue under reinforced compliance protocols per CRC audit request. Temescal demands speed without sacrificing safety—we're delivering both.

statements.decision: Phase 1 closed with HCAI seismic approval
statements.quote: HCAI stamped Sheet S-7.3 at 4:37 PM yesterday—that's the last structural note resolved. Caisson drilling finishes Thursday, three days ahead of schedule.
statements.fullStatement: HCAI's first-comment window closed with all seismic deficiencies resolved—no redesign required, just clarifying annotations. We've completed 94% of excavation and will finish caisson drilling this cycle. The double shifts stay, but we've added a third QC spot-check per shift at the contractor's cost per CRC's audit terms. Next up: foundation walls and slab pour. Phase 2 starts when the last caisson passes inspection—watch the site bulletin board.

trackerUpdates.MilestoneNotes: C103: HCAI seismic approval completed; excavation 94% done; caisson drilling finishing
trackerUpdates.NextScheduledAction: Foundation wall forming and slab pour

statements.decision: Added neighborhood liaison for construction updates
statements.quote: The pharmacist at 47th & Telegraph gets more questions about our crane schedule than I do. Starting next week, his bulletin board gets daily progress photos.
statements.fullStatement: Temescal's patience is why we're ahead—they've tolerated the noise, the dust, the early-morning deliveries. Starting next cycle, we're posting daily progress photos at four neighborhood hubs: the pharmacy, the library, the senior center, and that bench at 51st where Mr. Aldridge holds court every afternoon. Concrete dates, real visuals—no marketing fluff.
